title: Cefalium® Compared to Tylenol® in the Treatment of Migraine Attacks
brief_summary: National clinical trials, phase III, randomized, open, parallel, study of superiority, in which three hundred thirty-six (336) participants of both sexes, aged between 18 and 65 years will be randomly allocated to one of two treatment groups. The Group 01 will use Cefalium® and group 02 will use Tylenol®.
